stock.description: Operating across China, Jiangxi Rimag Group Co., Ltd. specializes in providing medical imaging services. The company delivers a comprehensive suite of diagnostic imaging procedures, including MRI, CT, PET scans, X-rays, ultrasounds, and mammography, serving both patients and other healthcare sector clients. It also offers sophisticated imaging solution services. Additionally, Rimag Cloud provides various digital offerings such as cloud-based storage and film modules, a cloud radiology information system (RIS), a cloud Picture Archive and Communication System (PACS), alongside modules for AI integration and operational management within imaging platforms. The firm also oversees and manages a medical imaging platform that hosts a diverse range of imaging-related services. Supporting its activities is a dedicated research and development center, and it further engages in the distribution of medical equipment and related consumables. Established in 2014, the company maintains its primary office in Beijing, China.
